# Colecto v0.5.0

Background services installed from an AppImage start again, the app recovers when its
mail service is down, sliders respond to touch, and the command runner can reload the
app.

## Background services on Linux

- **AppImage services start again.** Services installed or updated from an AppImage
  failed on every start (`open dir error: No such file or directory`, exit status 127):
  the service setting `NoNewPrivileges` stopped the AppImage from mounting itself.
  Services for an AppImage now leave that setting out. After upgrading, open
  Settings → Connection and press **Update** on the mail service and the notifier.
- **Failures are reported.** Install, Start and Update now check that the service
  stays running. If it stops, you see "The service did not start" and the
  `journalctl` command that shows why, instead of a success message.
- **A way back when the service is down.** If the app starts while its mail service
  does not answer, it shows "Can’t reach your mail" instead of "Mail workspace
  disabled". It retries every few seconds and opens your mail when the service is
  back. It also offers to update or start the service, or to use the app's own mail
  instead. See
  [background services](https://github.com/hexvale-labs/colecto/blob/v0.5.0/docs/self-hosting.md#unit-versions-and-updates).

If you are on v0.4.0 with an AppImage and the mail service is already failing, update
the app first. The new screen then offers **Update the mail service**, which fixes it.

## Settings

- **Sliders respond to touch.** In the Android app, a finger never moved a slider.
  Touch and pen now drag a slider directly, a tap jumps to where it lands, and a
  vertical swipe still scrolls. On touch screens the thumb is larger. This has been
  tested in emulated mobile browsers, not yet on a physical Android or iOS device.

## Command runner

- **Reload the app.** Search for "reload" in the command runner (`Ctrl K`). It works
  even while the app is busy, and asks first if you have unsaved changes.

## Downloads and limits

Downloads are the same as in v0.4.0 and are still not code-signed; see
[installing](https://github.com/hexvale-labs/colecto/blob/v0.5.0/docs/install.md). The
[known limits](https://github.com/hexvale-labs/colecto/blob/v0.5.0/docs/roadmap.md)
still apply, and storage formats may change between alpha versions.
